branches.title: Cornea
branches.summary: Refraction data (diopter, curvature), astigmatism (WTR/ATR), 5-layer anatomy (540-560μm), topography, pachymetry, specular microscopy, corneal findings, HSV keratitis, corneal dystrophy, transplantation (DALK, DSAEK, PK), LASIK, MSC injection, exosome research

branches.title: Lens and Cataract
branches.summary: NHI reimbursement criteria (age≥55, VA≤0.5), lens structure, cataract types (age-related, childhood, secondary), slit-lamp grading (NS, CO, PSC), IOL power formulas, phacoemulsification, IOL choices (multifocal, aspheric), complications (TASS, endophthalmitis)

branches.title: Glaucoma
branches.summary: IOP & aqueous humor dynamics, ocular hypertension (>21mmHg), NTG, glaucoma types (POAG, PACG, NVG, pseudophakic, aphakic, uveitic), GON, OPP, gonioscopy, visual field, tonometry, acute angle closure emergency, medical/laser/surgical management

branches.title: Iris
branches.summary: Iris structure (stroma, sphincter/dilator muscle, pigmented epithelium), iris bombe, seclusio pupillae, aniridia

branches.title: Uveitis
branches.summary: Patient evaluation, pediatric uveitis, anterior uveitis (AAU, CMV, JIA, Fuchs), panuveitis (bilateral, multi-segment), posterior uveitis (toxoplasmosis), ocular nodules, post-operative uveitis

branches.title: Retina
branches.summary: Retinal anatomy (vitreous, circulation, blood-retinal barrier, choroid), CSNB, hemorrhage types (subretinal, subRPE, dot-blot, flame, suprachoroidal), vitreous disease (floaters, Terson, asteroid hyalosis, PVD), Purtscher retinopathy, RVO (CRVO/BRVO), amaurosis fugax, OIS, AMD, CSCR, pachychoroid, DR, RD, ERM, macular dystrophy (BVMD), CMV retinitis, ARN, PORN, vitreoretinal surgery

branches.title: Neuro-ophthalmology
branches.summary: Visual pathway & field defects, optic neuropathy (ethambutol, gaze-evoked amaurosis), Tolosa-Hunt syndrome, CN III/IV/VII palsy, oculosympathetic pathway (Horner), CN VII overactivity (BEB, hemifacial spasm), cavernous sinus & orbital apex syndromes, TVL, diplopia, ptosis, CIDP, Miller Fisher, dorsal midbrain, NMO, MS, INO, one-and-a-half, reflexes, migraine, papilledema, ophthalmoplegia

branches.title: Systematic
branches.summary: Systemic diseases with ocular manifestation: immunotherapy irAE (uveitis, vitritis, retinal vasculitis), Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease, phakomatoses

branches.title: Pediatric ophthalmology
branches.summary: Pediatric red eye, strabismus, tearing (congenital glaucoma, epiblepharon), amblyopia (visual development, critical period), leukocoria, congenital corneal opacities, inherited eye diseases, fetal vessels (PFV), pediatric trauma/glaucoma, hyperopia, nanophthalmos, malignancy, albinism, DM, Marfan, nystagmus

branches.title: Ophthamlology medication
branches.summary: Blood-ocular barrier, glaucoma meds (combination, inflow/outflow), mydriatics & cycloplegics (phenylephrine, tropicamide, atropine, cyclopentolate), allergic disease, anti-inflammation, uveitis meds, antibiotics, antiviral, antifungal, artificial tears, diagnostic agents (Alcaine), drug side effects/toxicity

branches.title: GVHD
branches.summary: Graft-versus-host disease ocular involvement (cornea, conjunctiva, lacrimal gland, meibomian gland), onset 6-9mo post-BMT, chronic GVHD, treatment (artificial tears, autologous serum, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)

branches.title: Case discussion
branches.summary: Morning & subspecialty case rounds: real clinical cases with CC/PI/impression/management, covering diplopia, orbital cellulitis, keratitis (HSV, microsporidia), ACG, RD, chemical burns, CSCR, VKH, Tolosa-Hunt, cavernous sinus syndrome, ERM, perimetry

branches.title: Meta-analysis
